text: Android decodes stored expenses with strict Json.Default; one new server key would hide every expense

Fixed in 3c8f915: one lenient AppJson (ignoreUnknownKeys) provided by JsonModule and used for the stored expense in ItemsRepo.decodeExpense/encodeExpense and in SyncEngine's push-DTO decode (where Json.Default would have thrown and taken the whole push down). New ItemsRepoTest case decodes an expense with an unknown key; fails on the old code.
